name: Diamond Model intrusion analysis
description: Structures intrusion reporting into the four Diamond Model vertices with meta-features, confidence and gaps, IOCs, a diamond diagram and recommendations. Use it to brief stakeholders on an attack without them reading the full reports.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Source material
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Paste the report(s), article text or analyst notes to analyse. Leave empty to let the agent collect from your connected integrations.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Product or service
manual_trigger_parameters.description: The intelligence product you deliver to stakeholders.

name: Diamond Model from a validated extraction
description: Populates adversary, capabilities, infrastructure and victim strictly from a validated extraction or report, plus a confidence and gaps section, as input for a business-risk rating that stays with the analyst. Use it after IOC extraction and ATT&CK mapping.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Source material
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Paste the validated extraction and ATT&CK mapping, or the report itself. Leave empty to let the agent collect from your connected integrations.

name: Visual attack flow
description: Produces a stage-by-stage attack chain aligned to ATT&CK T-codes with IOCs per stage, a summary table and a one-page diagram. Use it to show technical teams or executives how an attack unfolded and where detection is needed.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Source material
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Paste the report(s), article text or analyst notes to analyse. Leave empty to let the agent collect from your connected integrations.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Product or service
manual_trigger_parameters.description: The intelligence product you deliver to stakeholders.

name: IOC extraction and enrichment (STIX 2.1)
description: Extracts every indicator from a report with its verbatim context, source and associated malware or TTPs, enriches it with your connected tools, and returns a strict STIX 2.1 bundle plus a validation table. Use it to prepare indicators for import into a TIP.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Source material
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Paste the report text (or its URL) to extract indicators from. Leave empty to let the agent collect from your connected integrations.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Write to an OpenCTI draft
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Put the extracted observables and indicators in a new OpenCTI draft for analyst review, and report the draft id. When off, nothing is written.
